module: Usage statistics displayed in the Easy Object Select tool panel: number of selections, transformed distance, number of translations/rotations/scalings, breakdown of world/local operations and rotations by R key/wheel, plus the cumulative volume (m^3) of the selection. draw() displays them in ImGui with a "Reset Stats" button.
notes: The counters are local to the module and only reset by the Reset Stats button.
The selection volume is cached and recomputed when the selection changes, when an object disappears or when the selection contains a BeamNGVehicle.

activate.desc: Initializes the coordinate mode and invalidates the volume cache.

isLocal.desc: true if the coordinate space is local.

setCoordinateMode.desc: Changes the coordinate mode used to classify operations (world or local).

recordSelection.desc: Increments the selection counter and invalidates the volume.

recordOperation.desc: Records a transform operation: increments the world/local counter, then transforms (and the cumulative distance), rotates (with source "r" or "wheel") or scales.

source.desc: For a rotation: "r" (R key) or "wheel" (mouse wheel).

invalidateVolume.desc: Forces recomputation of the selection volume at the next draw.

draw.desc: Displays the "Stats" block in ImGui (selected volume, counters, World/Local and R/Wheel progress bars, Reset Stats button).

selectedIds.desc: IDs of the selected objects, for the volume computation.
